text: في الدقيقة 82، قررت Ironvale Athletic اللعب بقوة أكبر والضغط على الخصم في مناطقهم الأمامية، لذا زادوا من سرعة الهجمات واعتمدوا على الكرات الطولية المباشرة[#1477]. هذا التغيير جعل الفريق يسيطر بشكل أكبر على الملعب ويطلق 5 تسديدات بعدما لم يطلق أي فرصة قبل التغيير[#1477]، وهو ما يعني أنهم حاولوا بقوة لتسجيل هدف التعادل. ولكن رغم تحسن الأداء في الملعب، لم يستطيعوا تعديل النتيجة التي ظلت Redmond Rovers 3 و Ironvale Athletic 2[#1477].

- Ironvale Athletic, trailing 2-3 at the 82nd minute, adjusted their tactics to press higher up the pitch and increase directness in their play, reflected by increased press (0.22 to 0.4), directness (0.66 to 0.81), and line height (0.25 to 0.37) [#1477].  
- This shift from their usual low block, deep defensive line, and vertical passing style towards a more aggressive, direct approach aligns with their 5-3-2 formation emphasizing counter-attacks but now attempting to regain possession higher and push for an equalizer.  
- The tactical change led to a significant rise in field tilt (from 5.9% to 65.2%) and shots (from 0 to 5), as well as box touches (from 1 to 8), indicating that Ironvale increasingly dominated attacking territory and chances after the adjustment [#1477].  
- Despite increased pressing and attacking intent, Ironvale's PPDA (opponent passes per defensive action) slightly worsened (5.5 to 5.8), and high turnovers doubled (1 to 2), showing their riskier, direct style may have cost them some possession security.
